title: Austin Leaders Plan Future Strategy
summary:
*   Austin's city leaders convened a special meeting on February 5, 1986, to discuss future direction.
*   The Mayor announced an upcoming work session specifically dedicated to Strategic Planning for the city.
*   All elected officials were present, highlighting the importance placed on this planning initiative.
